READING

**The fixed cost both courses share**

The problem states explicitly that the crossing-curve overshoot—28 extra remakes per technician × 10 technicians × £96 = £27,072—is identical under both courses. It therefore drops out of the comparison entirely, and the decision rests on the costs that differ.

---

**What KIRKBANE costs that AVENSWOOD does not**

KIRKBANE requires £44,000 of overtime. That is a certain, contracted, bounded sum.

---

**What AVENSWOOD costs that KIRKBANE does not: crossing remakes**

The pilot logged 40 crossing remakes in four months while two technicians straddled the boundary between the two systems. That is approximately ten crossing remakes per month at an interface of 2-new / 10-old.

AVENSWOOD runs two systems for roughly nine months. The interface is not constant:

| Phase | Period | New bench | Old bench | Est. crossing rate | Est. remakes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Jan–Apr 2027 (3 months) | 3 | 9 | ~12–15 / month | ~40 |
| 2 | Apr–Jul 2027 (3 months) | 6 | 6 | ~18–20 / month | ~55 |
| 3 | Jul–Oct 2027 (3 months) | 9 | 3 | ~12–15 / month | ~40 |

Estimated total crossing remakes under AVENSWOOD: ~135, costing roughly £12,960.

Even if that estimate is generous and the true figure is doubled to 270 (£25,920), AVENSWOOD is still cheaper than KIRKBANE by around £18,000. To make KIRKBANE financially competitive on this line alone, crossing remakes would need to reach about 458—roughly eleven times the pilot's monthly rate sustained for nine months—which is implausible given that the pilot generated those 40 remakes precisely because the transition was unexpected and processes were untested; AVENSWOOD enters the nine months with defined protocols from the pilot experience.

**Net financial position: AVENSWOOD is ahead by approximately £31,000.**

---

**The simultaneous-spike problem under KIRKBANE**

When all ten remaining technicians move together in January 2027, the lab-wide remake rate jumps immediately. The two pilot technicians account for 2/12 of the bench and are near their settled rate (~3.4%). The ten moving technicians account for 10/12 of the bench and are at 11.4%. Blended, the lab-wide rate hits roughly:

(10/12 × 11.4%) + (2/12 × 3.4%) ≈ **10.1%**

That is a rate more than three times the established baseline of 3.1%, and all forty practices see it in the same month. Even with advance communication, dental practices absorb the operational cost of remakes—rescheduling patients, waiting for replacements, re-seating appointments. A synchronised spike of this magnitude arriving simultaneously across the entire client base in a single calendar month creates a reputational exposure that is very difficult to put a number on but is very real.

Under AVENSWOOD, the maximum blended lab rate at any point is:

(3/12 × 11.4%) + (9/12 × 3.1%) ≈ **5.2%**

That is a modest and dispersed degradation. Individual practices are unlikely to attribute it to a systemic change; most will see only a slight increase in one or two crowns. The quality signal reaching the market is dramatically quieter.

---

**The dual-library risk**

Running two shade libraries and two material libraries for nine months is genuinely messy, and the pilot confirms cases can fall between the cracks. However, the pilot also means the laboratory already has live experience managing this boundary. Defined triage rules—which system owns a case, written hand-off notes at each stage—are already being developed rather than invented fresh. This is a manageable operational cost, not a structural one, and it ends completely when the last technician moves in October 2027.

---

**Deadline check**

Kessendale loses support on 2028-06-30. Under AVENSWOOD the last technician moves off Kessendale on 2027-10-04, leaving eight months of clear air before the deadline. There is no support-window risk under either course.

---

**Summary of differentials**

| Item | KIRKBANE | AVENSWOOD |
|---|---|---|
| Overtime | £44,000 | £0 |
| Additional crossing remakes | £0 | ~£12,960 |
| **Net additional cost** | **£44,000** | **~£12,960** |
| Lab remake rate peak | ~10.1%, all 40 practices simultaneously | ~5.2%, dispersed |
| Dual-library period | 0 months | ~9 months |
| Off old system by | 2027-01-04 | 2027-10-04 |

AVENSWOOD is financially superior by approximately £31,000, and it avoids placing a highly visible simultaneous quality shock in front of every practice relationship the laboratory holds.

---

CALL
AVENSWOOD

GROUNDS
The £44,000 overtime charge under KIRKBANE exceeds any plausible estimate of AVENSWOOD's additional crossing-remake cost by roughly £30,000, and the staggered timeline avoids a simultaneous remake-rate spike of around 10% landing across all forty practices in the same month.
